text:
maria: quick alert — big reconnect spike in eu-west at 09:17 UTC. clients drop then hammer reconnects during key rotations.
kevin: logs? resume or fresh auth?
maria: mostly resume. sample:
```
[09:17:02] GET /stream resume_id=abc -> 401
[09:17:02] proxy keyring refresh (lock) hold ~900ms
[09:17:03] auth validate -> 200; SSE opens -> client EOF -> reconnects
```
raj: that lock on hot path will thundering herd at scale.
sara: short fixes: (1) proxy returns 503 + Retry-After when rotation-flag set (reduce hammer), (2) SDKs recommend randomized jittered backoff for 401s, (3) add server-side dedupe window (3s) keyed by resume_id to avoid duplicate billable sessions.
kevin: note: returning 503 alters metric/billing attribution; coordinate with billing. also add keyring_refresh_block_ms metric to console.
ops-bot: incident INC-2026-501 created (assigned kevin).
raj: i'll add exporter for keyring_refresh_block_ms and prototype dedupe LRU with TTL=3s.
sara: i'll open a feature-flagged PR for proxy to emit 503+Retry-After=10s during rotation and wire the metric. canary: 5% eu-west.
maria: dashboard ask: current is `sum(rate(sse_reconnect_total[5m])) by (region)`. please add `avg(auth_handoff_latency_ms) by (tenant, region)` heatmap and an annotation track for deploys touching auth so on-call sees correlations.
kevin: plan: (A) proxy hotfix canary -> 5% eu-west, (B) SDK note + client-edge throttle, (C) metric + dashboard tile, (D) dedupe patch. watchlist: sse_reconnect_rate, auth_handoff_latency_ms, keyring_refresh_block_ms, sse_reconnect_billing_delta.
maria: please post canary graphs here after rollout.
kevin: will report after 10:30 canary.
